options.name: access_token
options.description: The access token used to authenticate.

options.name: auth_kind
options.description: The type of credential used.

options.name: custom_environment_spec
options.description: Compute configuration to use for an execution job.

options.name: dataform_repository_source
options.description: The Dataform Repository containing the input notebook.

options.name: direct_notebook_source
options.description: The content of the input notebook in ipynb format.

options.name: display_name
options.description: The display name of the Notebook Execution.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: execution_timeout
options.description: Max running time of the execution job in seconds (default 86400s / 24 hrs).

options.name: execution_user
options.description: The user email to run the execution as.

options.name: gcs_notebook_source
options.description: The Cloud Storage uri for the input notebook.

options.name: gcs_output_uri
options.description: The Cloud Storage location to upload the result to. Format:`gs://bucket-name`.

options.name: location
options.description: The location for the resource: https://cloud.google.com/colab/docs/locations.

options.name: notebook_execution_job_id
options.description: User specified ID for the Notebook Execution Job.

options.name: notebook_runtime_template_resource_name
options.description: The NotebookRuntimeTemplate to source compute configuration from.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used.

options.name: service_account
options.description: The service account to run the execution as.

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should exist in GCP.
